company.name: QueueHop
company.shortDescription: QueueHop is a mobile self-checkout solution with an RFID-enabled anti-theft tag.
company.description:
QueueHop is a Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) anti-theft apparel security tag that automatically unlocks after a payment is made.

QueueHop gives customers the option to self-checkout on their phones, without the hassle of having to wait in line.
